This source may clarify authoring versus runtime responsibilities; it does not prove our design or implementation.

The worth decision can use the actual repository source/checklist and primary text; no assumed source-image authority. A later generation brief must supply a complete original visual language and exact appearance criteria, independent critique and root verification. No generation or new image in this worth stage. No old realistic-character/groom/gesture/face/geometry/material/renderer/native-observer recipe is reopened; no Mii or expression-pair successor is admitted.

Root seals its first decision before critic opinion. The existing independent quality critic reads the same exact selected sources, gives actual source witnesses, explanation and two alternatives/tradeoffs, and answers whether the exact next brief is worth doing.
